properties.note: CORRECTS THE STALE CONTRIBUTION FOUND 2026-09-11 (fact:the-budget-edges-still-carry-the-pre-fix-numbers-so-budget-report-says-exceeded-for-a-budget-that-holds). This edge carried 12,502 ms — the PRE-fix figure from 2026-09-05 — so budget_report reported `exceeded` on a budget that actually held, and a tool sweep told Anthony both performance constraints were breached five days after they were not. The previous session deliberately left the number alone because which figure belonged in a budget named "warm" was a judgement: 1,912 ms warm or 6,354 ms after a write. That ambiguity is now gone — con:loop-status-after-a-write-answers-under-one-second carries the after-write case, so this budget takes the warm number and nothing else. 1,291 ms measured this date on a physical copy of the live store, 0.59.0 release, shared transport with --export-to, load 0.1-0.4, median of 4 calls with no write between them. This budget HOLDS at 65% of its 2,000 ms limit.
